description: FAIRY MUSIC v1.0.1 — Restored Listen Together party mode with instant auto-approval, fixed Google/YouTube account login, and enhanced stability.

changelog.title: Listen Together Party Mode
items: Enabled Instant Auto-Approval by default for seamless room joining
Added real-time In-App Pop-up Dialog for instant host approval/rejection
Added direct Auto-Approve toggle inside the active room card
Fixed relay server client handshake to prevent room hosting rejections

changelog.title: Account & Login System
items: Bypassed Google's 'disallowed_useragent' browser block with modern mobile UA
Enabled cross-domain third-party cookie sync for secure Google authentication
Resilient session capture ensuring library and private playlist access
Added instant login feedback and graceful account state recovery

changelog.title: Tactile UI & OTA Stability
items: Smoothed spring-physics animations and bouncy feedback
Dual-channel in-app OTA updates with zero-delay release resolution
